description: Verify that Subscribe ttl=0 (StopSubscribe) — DUT must not emit Ack/Nack
approach:
[Objective]
TTL=0 is the StopSubscribe sentinel — it's an unsubscribe, not a subscribe; DUT must not respond with an Ack.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → Tester: OfferService with IPv4 endpoint.
2. Tester → DUT: SubscribeEventgroup with TTL=0.
3. Observation: DUT must NOT emit Ack/Nack.

[Pass condition]
Observed DUT behaviour matches the spec property.

[Fail condition]
Per-phase Fail_phase<n>_* per the verdict list.

verdicts.Pass: DUT silent on TTL=0 subscribe — normal
verdicts.Fail_phase1_no_offer_with_endpoint: No OfferService with IPv4 endpoint within listen window
verdicts.Fail_phase2_dut_responded_to_ttl_zero: DUT emitted subscribe response for TTL=0 request
